status: PROPOSED plan (2026-10-21 UTC). Runs only after the old-vs-new comparison returns GO (plans/comparison_design.json :: decision_after). Budgets and rung training sizes are NOT frozen here.
nesting: D_0.86M ⊂ D_1.60M ⊂ D_2.96M ⊂ D_5.50M, all prefixes of ONE master order of stage2.reasoning_master@v1 (aadistill.data.nested_ladder.build_ladder); each rung's increment packed best-fit on its own so rung k is blocks[:n_k]; the in-training validation tail is reserved outside every rung
held_constant_across_rungs: the stratum shares (corpus_spec.json :: shares), checked per rung as max_share_deviation; family coverage is reported per rung (round-robin ordering gives a small rung the most families its size allows)
recorded_per_rung: distinct families and generators per stratum

training.independence: every rung trains from the SAME initialization, independently; no rung continues another rung's checkpoint
training.regime: fixed epochs (3), so training compute GROWS with the rung, as in E1; a fixed-compute ladder would be a separate protocol
training.recipe: the comparison's fixed recipe and its compute contract (M1: truncate_padding on; steps follow the rung's blocks at the comparison's supervised tokens per step)
training.reuse: the 2.96M rung's two units are the comparison's NEW arm, not retrained

comparability: NOT comparable point-for-point with E1: E1 trained PCA initializations on corpus_v2 with a different packer (cut sessions). The curve is compared with E1 only descriptively.
analysis: per unit and per axis, correctness and usability side by side at each rung; the dose-response is described (4 rungs x 2 seeds), with the rule-family cluster bootstrap per rung; no saturation point is claimed from four rungs
